_comment: PLACEHOLDER recipe proving the crafting gate end to end. Realized only once you UNDERSTAND the rock (its moss cleared -- the same flag the cache deed sets), so crafting gates on the observe/thought chain. Inputs: gathered thyme. Output: a consumable whose quality scales on the doing-layer stat + a roll. Making it feeds that stat XP (inverse to mastery) and, the first time, reveals a flag (the two-way loop hook). Tune/replace when the craft act + real content land.
